name: explore
description: Use to find files in the current and sub directories of the project

name: read
description: Use to read text files in the current directory, try with the provided path before using explore tool

path.description: The path of the file to read

name: write
description: Use to write text content to files, this is a overwriting process, so for existent files the content should be readed first

path.description: The path of the file to read

content.description: The content to write to the file

name: search
description: Use to search for information on web and for getting urls to be used with the `fetch` tool

name: fetch
description: Use to retrieve the entire data from url/links passed by the user or resulted from the `search` tool when the data on it is not enough

name: bash
description: Use to execute linux shell commands, you can use `git` to analyze project commits and previous iterations of files or executing testing code with `python3` when needed, you also can use it to create folders and move folders and files around when needed, never run a project directly, make it to run in a subprocess pointing the stdout to a temporary file in `/tmp`

command.description: The command to be executed in plain bash
